lines.text: In the second year, the LORD tells Moses in the Tent of Meeting to count men twenty or older.
The LORD names tribal leaders, like Elizur of Reuben and Nahshon of Judah, and Moses and Aaron take them.
Moses counts the tribes in the Wilderness of Zin, and Judah numbers 74,600.
Moses, Aaron and the twelve leaders count 603,550 men, but the Levites are not numbered with them.
God commands the Levites to camp around the tabernacle so that no wrath falls on the congregation of Judah.
